## Highlights

- OpenAI gateway accounts now recover from revoked access-token generations without
  reusing rejected credentials. A late usage response cannot overwrite a terminal
  refresh refusal, so an affected account stays out of the shared pool until a
  new generation is available. Generic usage failures keep their existing retry
  behavior. [#4664](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4664),
  [#4667](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4667)
- `tale deploy observe`, which v0.5.81 introduced
  ([#4648](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4648)), now keeps its
  retained-state checks and refusal phases bounded to read-only evidence,
  including portable lock and native-artifact validation. Observation never
  applies deployment changes or certifies readiness.
  [#4655](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4655),
  [#4657](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4657),
  [#4660](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4660),
  [#4662](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4662)
- CLI release checks now include every command suite, keep hashed workflow sources
  byte-stable on Windows, and reject receipt symlinks on platforms without
  `O_NOFOLLOW`. This prevents a platform-specific release from silently skipping
  a CLI suite or accepting a redirected receipt. [#4668](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4668)
- Automations are drawn on a canvas that lays itself out and reads like the run
  it describes. **Start** shows the trigger in words, its next run and its
  inputs; **End** shows the output's shape and the ways a run ends. Each `when`
  reads in words, a step and its `elseOf` alternative branch as **Yes** and
  **No**, and steps that may not run are dashed. A failed run opens on its
  failure. Every step field edits in a code editor that completes from the steps
  before it, a run's input is typed there too, and **Source** shows the stored
  document as read-only YAML. A **List** view is the text alternative, the
  canvas is keyboard navigable and does not animate under reduced motion, and
  connector actions carry titles in English, German and French.
  [#4621](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4621)
- Typing with an input method (IME), as for Chinese, Japanese or Korean, no
  longer sends or discards unfinished text: the Enter or Escape that confirms a
  candidate stays with the input method when editing a sent message, a task
  title or a label's name, in the label search and in agent answers, and a
  dialog or popover no longer closes mid-composition. Escape on an edited task
  title now discards the edit instead of saving it.
  [#4242](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4242)
- A task run stopped because its sandbox ran out of memory is retried after 2,
  10 and then 30 minutes, as intended; the longer waits used to end after about
  5 minutes. An automation's agent step starts again after 2 minutes. The
  failure no longer promises a retry: it reads "Start the agent again — if it
  keeps happening, ask an Admin to give agents more memory." Worker cleanup
  removes stale task input copies again when 50 older copies belong to tasks
  still open. [#4643](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4643)
- Views whose data fails to load now say so and offer a retry instead of an
  empty or misleading state: recent feedback in analytics
  ([#4372](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4372)), Guardrails' recent
  events instead of "No events yet"
  ([#4373](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4373)), sandbox quota
  allocations, whose fields and **Save** stay disabled until they load
  ([#4376](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4376)), the project
  breadcrumb, which keeps the project's name
  ([#4383](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4383)), a pending agent
  question instead of **Working**, keeping its answer drafts
  ([#4388](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4388)), the import status
  on the **OAuth apps** card, shown as "Status unavailable"
  ([#4400](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4400)), and Legal Hold
  matters, whose retry moves focus to the **Matters** section
  ([#4327](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4327)).
- The **Unread** notifications tab says "You have older unread notifications ·
  Load more to see them." when only older ones are left to load, instead of
  saying you are all caught up
  ([#4394](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4394)). After switching
  organizations, the browser's Back button returns to the page before the
  switch instead of the switching page
  ([#4410](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4410)).
- Also fixed: the contact details dialog shows any stored address instead of
  failing on a nested one ([#4224](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4224));
  task search ranks matches in a task's fields and in its comments together,
  active tasks before archived ones and newest first, up to 25
  ([#4248](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4248)); a product stock
  typed as `1e3` is saved as 1000, not 1
  ([#4251](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4251)); creating or
  revoking a personal API key updates the key lists of a person's other
  organizations at once instead of up to five minutes later
  ([#4382](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4382)); a bulk Inbox reply
  keeps its literal tags and line breaks
  ([#4389](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4389)); switching
  Microsoft 365 sources clears the previous source's folders, search and
  selection, and a file imported from a SharePoint library's root lands in the
  chosen folder ([#4398](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4398)); the
  Contacts **Source** filter offers all 25 contact sources instead of four
  ([#4406](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4406)); and after a
  project's **Audience** changes, **New agent** › **Skills** offers the skills
  of the saved audience ([#4407](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4407)).
- Sandbox cache permission helpers run the local runtime image by its exact
  image ID, never pull an image and have no network, so a retagged image cannot
  swap the helper that runs as root.
  [#4609](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4609)

## Upgrade notes

- Deploy the Tale platform and CLI together before adopting these fixes.
  Managed deployments use the shared Tale CLI source from `13a41556`.
- No database migration is included in this release. Keep the existing backup,
  retained-release and configuration readback procedure, and verify the gateway
  account state after rollout before sending new task turns.
- Mailbox connector ports must be whole numbers from 1 to 65535
  ([#4260](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4260)). A mailbox
  credential an earlier release saved with another port used to fall back to
  the default port; it now fails with `CREDENTIAL_UNRESOLVED` until its port is
  corrected in **Settings** › **Connectors**.
- The automation canvas ignores the step positions earlier releases stored under
  `ui.positions` and lays every automation out itself; a save keeps them in the
  document ([#4621](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/pull/4621)).
- The `v0.5.82` tag and its source archives name
  `0381bc439d9de85079bcdd4e001ad7e989f76bb9`. Release run
  [38001085799](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/actions/runs/38001085799)
  built the `0.5.82` images from it, and an image's
  `org.opencontainers.image.revision` label names the commit it was built from;
  CLI run
  [38003101797](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/actions/runs/38003101797)
  built the CLI binaries attached to this release from it. The tag first named
  `81ef78dcd1363c3aef04b6e8b92c9780c99e11f7`, then
  `e6fb96249d43494dc82922995615b525cdc0f5c3`, and Release runs 37997069367 and
  37998909930 published `0.5.82` images from those commits: if you pulled
  `0.5.82` before 23:07 UTC on 2026-10-09, pull it again.
- These notes were corrected after v0.5.82 was published
  ([#4741](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/issues/4741)): they were written
  for `81ef78dcd` and described only the gateway, observation and CLI release
  check fixes, and the tag then moved to `0381bc439`, 25 merges later.
